articles.headline: Jhon Arias guides Colombia past Ghana into round of 16
articles.description: Colombia booked the last place in the World Cup's round of 16 as they beat Ghana 1-0 in Kansas City. Jhon Arias grabbed the only goal after 14 minutes as the earned a meeting with Switzerland in Vancouver.

articles.headline: Colombia see off Ghana to head back to World Cup round of 16
articles.description: Colombia controlled Ghana on a sweltering night at Arrowhead Stadium, allowing Los Cafeteros to advance to the round of 16 at the World Cup with a 1-0 victory Friday night.
